question: In relation to the attempt to access Primary Refresh Token (PRT), can you identify the name of the process involved in this activity?
answer: BrowserCore.exe — the process spawned by powershell.exe running get-userprttoken.ps1 (itself launched via WMI by wmiprvse.exe) to access the Primary Refresh Token. The chain was: wmiprvse.exe → powershell.exe (get-userprttoken.ps1) → BrowserCore.exe, with curl.exe (curl http://vectorsandarrows.com) also spawned by WmiPrvSE.exe.

actions.sql: SELECT * FROM DeviceProcessEvents WHERE FileName LIKE '%get-userprttoken%' OR ProcessCommandLine LIKE '%get-userprttoken%' OR ProcessCommandLine LIKE '%prttoken%' LIMIT 20
